name: New Word Meanings and Semantic Gaps in the Next 1–10 Years
gap: When new technologies, new institutions and new lifestyles emerge, existing words are forced to take on new referential, evaluative and relational functions.
lexical: new meaning of old words
metaphorical extension
metonymic extension
popularization of technical terms
terminologization of common words
note: Level-1 domains are expanded in parallel; level-2 domains refer to positions where semantic gaps are more likely to emerge in the future; level-3 nodes provide observable directions of new meaning emergence.

children.name: AI Agents and Collaborative Cognition
children.gap: As software shifts from 'tools' to actors capable of planning, negotiation and execution, the boundaries of existing words such as 'assistant, agent, colleague, responsibility' need to be redefined.

colleague
entrustment
takeover
co-signing

task relay

children.name: Machine Handoff

model credential
